caption: The drawing depicts a wooden music stand composed of several parts. At the top, there is a blue-framed holder with decorative, curved edges that contains an open book with two visible pages marked with vertical blue and yellow lines. Beneath the book holder is a rectangular, reddish-brown box with a drawer, visible from its front face and featuring a metal knob on the right side. The stand is supported by a single, turned wooden column that is also reddish-brown, exhibiting carved details and bulges along its length. At the bottom, the column extends into a tripod base with three ornate, curved legs. The overall composition is centered on a light beige background. The artist's name, "J. Cannella," is written in small, capitalized letters below the base of the stand.
title: Shaving Stand
